title: When All Rollouts Fail: Policy-Compatible Joint Decoding for Hard-Problem Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models. Yet it faces a learning cliff on problems beyond model's current ability: when every rollout fails, the samples reveal nothing about a correct solution, and group-relative estimators (e.g., GRPO, RLOO) collapse the update to zero advantage. Expert trajectories offer a remedy, but they are incompatible with the current policy and often lie in the student's low-probability regions, so the surviving updates demand large parameter shifts and decay into surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning. We argue that a useful learning signal on hard problems must be both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current policy. translated_title: 当所有采样全部失败时：面向困难问题推理的策略兼容联合解码
translated_abstract: 通过可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过在线策略探索从二值奖励中获取学习信号，已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的强大范式。然而，在超出模型当前能力的问题上，它面临“学习悬崖”：当每一次采样全部失败时，样本无法揭示任何关于正确解的信息，组相对估计器（如GRPO、RLOO）会将优势更新坍缩为零。专家轨迹提供了一种补救方法，但它们与当前策略不兼容，往往位于学生模型的低概率区域，因此存留的更新需要大幅的参数变化，并退化为表面模仿而非可迁移的推理。我们认为，在困难问题上的有用学习信号必须同时满足两点：可验证的正确性，以及与当前策略的充分兼容性。我们提出了策略兼容强化学习（PICO），它执行分布式……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出策略兼容强化学习方法PICO，通过策略兼容的联合解码使专家轨迹与当前策略分布相容，从而在所有采样都失败、标准RLVR学习信号坍缩为零的困难问题上获得既可验证正确又可迁移的有效学习信号。
en_tdlr: Proposes PICO (Policy-Compatible Reinforcement Learning), which uses policy-compatible joint decoding to align expert trajectories with the current policy, providing verifiably correct and transferable learning signals on hard problems where all rollouts fail and standard RLVR collapses to zero advantage.
